title: 词频统计
brief: 实现 count_words(text)：按空白切分文本，返回「单词 -> 出现次数」的表；大小写不转换，空串返回空表。
hint: 用 text:gmatch('%S+') 逐个取词，counts[w] = (counts[w] or 0) + 1。
tests: local c = count_words('neon city neon'); assert(c.neon == 2, 'neon 应出现 2 次'); assert(c.city == 1, 'city 应出现 1 次')
local c = count_words(''); assert(next(c) == nil, '空串应返回空表')
local c = count_words('  a\tb\na  '); assert(c.a == 2 and c.b == 1, '空白符都应作为分隔')
local c = count_words('Neon neon'); assert(c.Neon == 1 and c.neon == 1, '不应擅自转换大小写')
local c = count_words('x'); assert(c.x == 1, '单个词也应计数')
solution:
function count_words(text)
  local counts = {}
  for w in text:gmatch('%S+') do
    counts[w] = (counts[w] or 0) + 1
  end
  return counts
end

local c = count_words('neon city neon')
print(c.neon, c.city)

title: 括号栈
brief: 实现 is_balanced(s)：只含 ()[]{} 的字符串，判断括号是否按正确顺序闭合；空串视为平衡。
hint: 左括号入栈；右括号必须与栈顶配对再弹出；扫完栈必须为空。
tests: assert(is_balanced('}{') == false, '右括号先出现应拒绝')
solution:
function is_balanced(s)
  local stack = {}
  local pairs = { [')'] = '(', [']'] = '[', ['}'] = '{' }
  for i = 1, #s do
    local ch = s:sub(i, i)
    if ch == '(' or ch == '[' or ch == '{' then
      table.insert(stack, ch)
    elseif ch == ')' or ch == ']' or ch == '}' then
      if #stack == 0 or table.remove(stack) ~= pairs[ch] then
        return false
      end
    end
  end
  return #stack == 0
end

print(is_balanced('({[]})'))
print(is_balanced('([)]'))

title: 偶数求和
brief: 实现 sum_even(t) 与 max_even(t)：sum_even 返回偶数和，max_even 返回最大偶数；空表或没有偶数时 max_even 返回 nil，sum_even 返回 0。
starterCode:
function sum_even(t)
  local total = 0
  return total
end

function max_even(t)
  return nil
end

print(sum_even({1,2,3,4}))
print(max_even({1,2,3,4}))
hint: 用 ipairs 遍历；max_even 维护 best，初始 nil，遇到偶数时比较并更新。
solution:
function sum_even(t)
  local total = 0
  for _, n in ipairs(t) do
    if n % 2 == 0 then total = total + n end
  end
  return total
end

function max_even(t)
  local best = nil
  for _, n in ipairs(t) do
    if n % 2 == 0 and (best == nil or n > best) then best = n end
  end
  return best
end
